idna 3.20: generated Unicode lookup tables

This attribution supplement accompanies the separately distributed, unmodified
idna dependency wheel. It does not replace idna's BSD-3-Clause license or change
the license of the dashboard application.

Artifact:
  idna-3.20-py3-none-any.whl
  SHA-256: ab7ae7122974553370f0bdb919e1a960b2cd1bc1ef0276416d896db81c14582c

Generated table members:
  idna/idnadata.py
  SHA-256: 23a9a8c1d15de9c634d0bf213d779810f485083fe1b0f7e09044ad04a69cc7eb

  idna/uts46data.py
  SHA-256: 770e849bfa156c71828a89440a57fe9aea70735f103ae4616ee4f682e13d6c00

Both members identify tools/idna-data as their generator and Unicode 18.0.0 as
their table version. The idna 3.20 release also identifies the Unicode 18.0.0
update. The upstream generator documentation describes calculating these tables
from Unicode source data. This notice does not attest to regeneration of the
wheel from a particular complete set of source inputs.

Unicode source data attribution:
  Copyright © 2026 Unicode, Inc.
  The Unicode 18.0.0 data references below identify Unicode's terms of use.
  The accompanying Unicode-LICENSE.txt preserves the complete Unicode License
  v3, including its copyright and permission notice. Keep it with this document
  as associated documentation when redistributing the selected idna wheel.

The additional Unicode notice is supplied conservatively for the generated
tables and their underlying data. Upstream distinguishes its packaged
calculated tables from the Unicode data files retrieved by the generator. This
supplement does not assert that idna's own license declaration is incorrect.

The table hashes identify the reviewed wheel members. A dependency update
requires a fresh check of its table version, included portions and notices.
